The '''Forward Bunker''' was a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] military installation that lay along the [[Frozen Footpath]], which ran through the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and linked [[Leth Outpost]] with [[Dorn Base]].
